beta.diagnosticsHelp: Beta also shows a Diagnostics button in the footer. It downloads and copies your names, start places, routes, fares, settings, the current URL and the areas shown on the map.

legal.summaryPrivacy: Summary: Your people and settings stay on this device. Place search and map tiles contact third-party providers; share links reveal the scenario in the URL. There is no account, analytics, or app backend.
legal.summaryTerms: Summary: Results are estimates, not navigation or professional advice. Check official operator information before travelling. The app is provided as is; you control what you enter and share.
legal.summaryCredits: Summary: Map data comes from OpenStreetMap, tiles from OpenFreeMap, search from Photon, and fares from MTR open data. Application code is MIT licensed.
legal.summaryProcess: Summary: Starts are matched to nearby stops, local routing computes travel times, and areas are sorted by fair time or fare spread. Bus fares are estimates.
